entries.zh: 醒眼：眼睛清明、目光警醒；睁眼看视时神志清醒。
entries.en: to have clear, alert eyes; to look with a wakeful, watchful eye.
entries.notes: L 栏作「miras .」，词形残断，义从 H「醒眼」与 M「seng guen」定。

entries.zh: 目不转睛地直盯着看；瞪视、凝视。
entries.en: to stare fixedly at; to fix one's eyes intently upon.

entries.zh: 凝神注视、看得出神（目光专注而入迷）。
entries.en: to gaze fixedly in contemplation; to be absorbed in looking.
entries.notes: H 第二字「瞷」当为「睭」（M 作 chiu，目睭即眼睛），据此定读。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕看而不见、看不清。
entries.en: 〔damaged original; gloss uncertain〕 to look without being able to see or make out.
entries.notes: L「Mirar no certificarse」义晦，H「着不見」字有疑（着/看），M「cuam quy」与 H 不能密合。

entries.zh: 斜视；侧目而看。
entries.en: to look sideways; to squint; a sidelong glance.

entries.zh: 无意中瞥见人；不经意地看人。
entries.en: to catch sight of someone unintentionally; to glance at someone without intent.
entries.notes: L 栏与上条重出（原书排比同义条目），义从 H「無意着人」；M 三音节对 H 四字，疑夺一音。

entries.zh: 抬眼瞄看；举目一瞥。
entries.en: to glance up at; to take a quick sight with the eyes, as if aiming.
entries.notes: M「chian quy」与 H「瞄起」声韵未密合，读音存疑。

entries.zh: 抬头远望、盼望；期待地注视。
entries.en: to gaze ahead expectantly; to look forward to.

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕或指仰望上天。
entries.en: 〔damaged original; gloss uncertain〕 perhaps to look up at the sky.
entries.notes: L 栏整条残缺，仅存 H「相上天」与 M「sio chio tỹ」，义据汉字推测，不敢定。

entries.zh: 探看水的深浅、测量水深。
entries.en: to look into the water to find its depth; to sound the depth of water.
entries.notes: L 栏残泐（「grime jisonso」不可读），H 首字有疑（首/水），M 与「度看偌深」相合。

entries.zh: 以目传情、抛媚眼；使眼色撩人（「使目箭射人」，谓眼波如箭伤人）。
entries.en: to make eyes at someone; to dart amorous glances (lit. to shoot a person with eye-arrows).

entries.zh: 约正：乡约之长，掌一乡风化、维护公益之人；亦可解作约束匡正。
entries.en: headman of the local covenant (xiangyue) who watches over public morals and the common good; also to discipline and rectify.
entries.notes: L「mirar por el bien comun」为职守的意译而非字面对译，故降一级。

entries.zh: 没药（末药）：一种芳香树脂，可入药、焚香。
entries.en: myrrh, an aromatic gum-resin used as medicine and incense.
entries.notes: L 作 Mirra；M「bur yo」当即「沒藥」bu̍t-io̍h，H 单字「藥」为省文；M 末附「vi ni [残]」未详。

entries.zh: 看视有节、目光检点（守礼不直视）；H 栏「儉省」本义节俭，与此不合，存疑。
entries.en: to look with modesty and restraint; a discreet, guarded gaze (the Chinese column reads 'frugal', which does not fit).
entries.notes: L 指目光端谨，H/M 却作「儉省」言节俭，两栏义不合，M 又残。

entries.zh: 怜悯、慈悲；怜恤人的。
entries.en: mercy, compassion; merciful, full of pity.

entries.zh: 仁慈、仁爱（慈悲之心）。
entries.en: benevolence and compassion; merciful kindness.
entries.notes: H 单字「仁」，M「xin chu」即「仁慈」jîn-tsû，合为一条。

entries.zh: 怜悯（「怜」为「憐」的俗写）。
entries.en: to pity; compassion (怜 as a popular variant of 憐).
entries.notes: H 字有疑（怜/憐）；M「leng」与「憐」常读 lîn/liân 不合，或为俗读别记。

entries.zh: 可怜、令人悯惜；怜悯。
entries.en: pitiable; to take pity on; compassion.

entries.zh: 恻隐（恻隐之心）、不忍人之心；仁慈的。
entries.en: commiseration, the feeling of pity (惻隱之心); merciful.
entries.notes: M「cheg un」即「惻隱」tshek-ún，可证 H 单字「惻」为省文。

entries.zh: 慈爱、慈悲。
entries.en: compassionate, loving-kind; merciful.

entries.zh: 恻怛：悲悯不忍、心地慈软。
entries.en: full of commiseration; tenderhearted, merciful.
